name: Origin Investment Corp I
summary: Origin Investment Corp I is a Special Purpose Acquisition Company (SPAC), established in 2024 under Cayman Islands jurisdiction, and headquartered in Singapore. Its core mission is to achieve a merger or acquisition with one or more enterprises. The company primarily seeks out potential targets within diverse sectors such as financial services, technology, life sciences (biotechnology and pharmaceuticals), high-performance materials, and renewable energy, with a particular strategic focus on businesses operating in Asia.
